header.title: Type 1 Diabetes Simulator
header.subtitle: UVA/Padova Physiological Model • Live Demonstration
header.boothPrompt: Observe how carbohydrates and insulin dynamics affect interstitial glucose in real time.

tir.title: Time in Range
tir.subtitle: 70 – 180 mg/dL
tir.description: Standard clinical target for reducing long-term microvascular complications.

tar.title: Time Above Range
tar.subtitle: > 180 mg/dL
tar.description: Acute hyperglycemia (L1: 180-250 mg/dL, L2: > 250 mg/dL). High risk of DKA if untreated.

tbr.title: Time Below Range
tbr.subtitle: < 70 mg/dL
tbr.description: Acute hypoglycemia (L1: 54-70 mg/dL, L2: < 54 mg/dL). Immediate safety risk.

riskIndex.title: Risk Index
riskIndex.subtitle: Composite Metabolic Risk
riskIndex.description: Kovatchev UVA/Padova composite metric quantifying glucose variability and instability.

lbgi.title: LBGI
lbgi.subtitle: Low Blood Glucose Index
lbgi.description: Quantifies the frequency and extent of hypoglycemia.

hbgi.title: HBGI
hbgi.subtitle: High Blood Glucose Index
hbgi.description: Quantifies the magnitude and exposure to hyperglycemia.

chart.playbackHint: Use playback controls to animate the daily trajectory for audience presentation.
